COL Group from Oaktree’s Power Opportunities strategy for an enterprise value of €810M, expanding its manufacturing capacity and power distribution capabilities in Europe.

Eaton said the acquisition will enhance its ability to address growing demand from data center and utility customers for resilient and sustainable power infrastructure, including integrated grid-to-chip power solutions. COL Group is forecast to generate €250M in sales in 2027.
The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2027.
The stock price increased about 1.3% on Friday pre-market.

title: Eaton expands Europe operations with €810M COL Group deal
